svg.text: Index Size vs Dataset Scale (PG18 BEIR Matrix)
x-axis: document count (log scale) | y-axis: PostgreSQL index relation size (log scale)
Note: size is PostgreSQL index relation bytes recorded as build_bytes in the PG18 matrix.
Representative largest dataset: msmarco | ids 2.98GiB | text[] 3.00GiB | pg_search 1.65GiB | vchord 12.59GiB
